target_customer: IT admins and finance leads at small and mid size companies that use many SaaS tools
problem: Admins track SaaS tools, licenses and user access with spreadsheets and surveys. Sorted used a Chrome extension to discover tools automatically and show costs and user access within minutes.
business_model: B2B SaaS, early access stage, pricing not found

founders.name: Adam Ingwersen
founders.background_notes: YC bio: tinkerer based in Denmark.

founders.name: Frederik Ingwersen
founders.background_notes: YC bio: engineer with people skills. A Crunchbase listing names Frederik Ingwersen Linnemann as co-founder and CTO.

exit.reason: Not public. YC lists it as Inactive and a dead startup aggregator says the product domain returns no content.

competitors.name: Zluri
competitors.what: SaaS management platform for IT teams
competitors.funding_then: 10 million dollar Series A led by MassMutual Ventures, January 2022

competitors.name: Zylo
competitors.funding_then: 31.5 million dollar Series C led by Baird Capital, November 2022

technical_complexity.rationale: A browser extension plus integrations to discover SaaS usage is standard engineering, though 50 plus integrations take effort.

defensibility.rationale: Funded competitors already offered discovery, and a Chrome extension approach is easy to copy.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Well funded SaaS management vendors kept raising money in 2022 and 2023. No acquisition of Sorted was found.

market_need_then: SaaS sprawl was a recognized cost and security issue and several vendors raised rounds in 2022 and 2023 to address it.

branding.domain_note: Landing page was on a Webflow subdomain, the getsorted.io domain is reported to return no content.

identity.voice_and_tone: Casual tagline: a tool to manage your tools

branding.brand_signature: A tool to manage your tools

brand_strength.rationale: Several other companies are named Sorted, including a UK logistics firm, and no brand press for this one was found.

outcome_analysis: Sorted was a two brother Danish team that entered W23 with an automated SaaS discovery tool in a field already crowded by Zluri, Zylo and Torii. Only the standard YC money is reported and the company is inactive with its domain reportedly dark. No shutdown statement exists, so the cause is not public and no failure factors are assigned.
notes: The landing page fetch showed an early access page with a 2023 copyright; live status could not be confirmed. The $500K comes from CB Insights (YC convertible note) and VCBacked (pre-seed, April 2023, which lists San Francisco). A ful.io blog claims over 2 million dollars and 21 employees; it is unattributed and was discounted. Torii also raised a 50 million dollar Series B in February 2022 per a search summary but no source URL was opened for it.
